about: char-face-1: claude-facet bodies with anime faces as textures (tools/style-concepts/facetface.py). One change per attempt; attempt-05/06 and 07/08 are two series that each start from attempt-04.

attempts.label: Before · claude-facet attempt-04
attempts.note: Round 1's faceted figures: box eyes, box glasses and brows on an eight-sided head.
attempts.read: What I see: the eyes are two dark boxes behind box glasses, which is the blank stare.

attempts.label: cf-01 · face texture on the old head
attempts.note: Change: the box eyes, glasses, brows and Eric's stubble shell come off; a painted face texture (eyes, brows, nose, mouth, glasses, Eric's stubble) is projected onto the front of the same eight-sided head, lit like the rest. Thin temple bars stay as geometry.
attempts.read: What I see: it reads as an anime face for the first time, with the portraits' half-lidded eyes and dark upper lash line. A facet edge runs down the middle of the face, so one half is lighter than the other. Mio's irises come out grey, not light tan.

attempts.label: cf-02 · + flat face shading
attempts.note: Change: every corner of the textured front gets one forward-facing normal, so the face shades as one plane and the facet edges no longer cut across the eyes. Geometry unchanged.
attempts.read: What I see: the face is one even tone and the split is gone. The face area is now brighter than the head's sides, and that edge shows in three-quarter view.

attempts.label: cf-03 · + smoother face front
attempts.note: Change: the front 120 degrees of the head are seven narrow sides instead of three wide ones (the back keeps five flat sides), so the face sits on a gently curved front.
attempts.read: What I see: the cheeks turn a little more smoothly in three-quarter view. From the front it looks almost the same as cf-02.

attempts.label: cf-04 · + ink outline
attempts.note: Change: a dark outline round every part (the inverted hull from claude-ink attempt-07, 8 mm wide here, 5 mm on small parts). This is level 1 of both series below.
attempts.read: What I see: the outline separates head, hair and body. The face itself is unchanged. At the game camera the face is about 8 pixels across, seen from above, and the eyes don't read; you see skin, glasses glint and hair.

attempts.label: cf-05 · simplification level 2
attempts.note: From cf-04, one change: simpler shapes. Two fewer sides on the body shapes, four-sided limbs, six-sided hair, no shoe soles.
attempts.read: What I see: blockier shapes. At the game camera it looks almost the same as cf-04.

attempts.label: cf-06 · simplification level 3
attempts.note: From cf-05, one change: simplest. Five-sided body shapes and hair, and no hands, soles, cuffs, side strand or extra hair pieces.
attempts.read: What I see: the plainest version, with no hands and simpler hair. The glasses' side bars stick out past Mio's hair, and at the game camera it looks about the same as cf-05.

attempts.label: cf-07 · stylization level 2
attempts.note: From cf-04, one change: proportions pushed toward chibi. Head 1.3 times bigger, legs 0.85 as long.
attempts.read: What I see: a bigger head and shorter legs. In the game the head is easier to pick out, but the face still doesn't read.

attempts.label: cf-08 · stylization level 3
attempts.note: From cf-07, one change: further toward chibi. Head 1.65 times bigger, legs 0.7 as long.
attempts.read: What I see: at the game camera this is the first level where the face shows as a face (eyes and glasses as dark marks), mostly on desktop. Up close Eric's head looks large and blocky.

attempts.label: cf-09 · + bolder face marks
attempts.note: From cf-04, one change: the face texture's dark lines (lashes, pupils, brows, frames, mouth, Eric's stubble) spread by 3 pixels with a round brush, for the game camera.
attempts.read: What I see: in the game the face is a little darker but not clearer than cf-04. Up close the bolder lines make Mio look like she's scowling, and Eric's stubble turns into dashes.

attempts.label: cf-10 · stylization 3 with the bolder face
attempts.note: cf-08's proportions with cf-09's face: the two changes that most help the face at the game camera, together.
attempts.read: What I see: in the game the face reads best of the round, but the difference from cf-08 is small. Up close it has the same harsh, scowling look as cf-09.
